EffectDescription.Key_mf_chorus_echo: Deal damage equal to this effect's value; if you have enough cards in hand, deal a smaller amount again.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_swarm_pull: Draw cards equal to this effect's value; if your discard pile is large enough, draw one more.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_chain_finish: Deal damage equal to this effect's value, plus more the larger your discard pile (up to 6).
EffectDescription.Key_mf_brood_call: Add Tadpoles equal to this effect's value to your hand.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_shield_bash: Deal damage equal to half your Block (a minimum applies if you have none), then lose all Block.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_bulwark_pray: Heal for a third of your Block (a minimum applies).
EffectDescription.Key_mf_last_bastion: Gain Block. If you are at half health or below, gain more Block and heal.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_molt_shell: Lose all Block and draw cards equal to this effect's value.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_feast: Draw cards, discard some at random, and gain 1 Purple mana.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_glut: Discard some random cards; gain 1 Black mana for each.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_renew: Heal. If you have very few cards in hand, draw 2 instead.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_void_tithe: Lose health, gain Block and Purple mana.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_king_decree: Deal damage (more with a larger hand) and apply Bleed to the opponent.
